integrity: Analytic proof with no numerical extrapolation; evidence is the theorem proof and dated primary scholarly sources. Independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to complex H2 analytic Toeplitz multipliers with symbols in the disk algebra. Distance and maximality are relative to the disk-algebra multiplier algebra; no individual-symbol exact distance or claim for all bounded Toeplitz operators. Related earlier norm-attainment classification and uninspected older literature are acknowledged.
title: Sharp half-norm nonattainment gap on a maximal Hardy multiplier ideal
